entries.back_en: Yes... this... Soldier, Brigard sent us to find you.
Yes, I know what must be going through your mind. "Why is there a city in the afterlife?" Well then, all of Terragaya's inhabitants died at some point, and our souls were "rescued" by the Valkyries.
I'm sure you think you must fulfil your mission. It's normal. After all, they're the ones who brought you here.

But you know what? We're still masters of our own destiny. What did they promise you? Glory and unimaginable powers if you place yourself in the service of the Gods? I don't believe in such a fate. I've always seen their mission as a way for us to make sense of our existence after death, y'know? To have a purpose.
But honestly, is that what we die for? To get involved in more war and suffering?
I founded this city to be a point of union between all the species that inhabit the universe and that seek a peaceful, eternal life without conflict.
I won't keep you any longer. The fact that you're still in your armour speaks for itself, but know that, if you change your mind, there is always a home for you in Hafin.
Captain Adamont was sent on a mission to the Sibuna Desert, west of the sanctuary where the Valkyries brought us.
It's been quite a while since I've had news of him. Not even Euder's explorers can locate him, and several of them have even disappeared.
Under normal circumstances I wouldn't ask this of a private, but you've shown courage in the past and I cannot leave my post while I coordinate the search for the Guardian.
I must say, to reach the Sibuna Desert you'll need to take a huge detour from here. It's a very long journey that will probably end in death and despair.

Talk to Gartua, the engineer. You'll find him at Hafin's entrance, up the steps. He probably won't listen to you, but just say who you are and what you did for me and he'll help you. That Dwarf owes me more than one favour and I'll use it to give you a hand.
Done. Oh, I hope this is important; I hate my work being interrupted. Obviously, I hate a lot of things... I'll turn a blind eye. So what's up?
entries.note: Acrescentou 'Oh' não presente, mas sem alterar sentido.

entries.back_en: Wait... Don't tell me you're that soldier he's been talking about so much!
No "buts", Edil. You're smart; you just need to focus on what you're doing. Rest a bit and we'll try again later.
Gruper, get moving, this is going to affect us too.
